description: Launch a Modal serverless function via Dagster Pipes and materialize the emitted asset(s) with the metadata the Modal function reports back. Streams logs + structured metadata + AssetMaterialization events over Pipes during the run — richer observability than the fire-and-track ModalAssetComponent. Requires the user's Modal function to open a `dagster_pipes.open_dagster_pipes()` context.

outputs.description: One primary asset whose materialization is triggered by the Modal function's PipesContext.report_asset_materialization(). Function can also emit additional asset materializations.

backfill_policy.label: Backfill Policy
backfill_policy.description: Backfill execution strategy for a partitioned asset. 'single_run' materializes an entire backfill range in one Dagster run, launching the Modal function once per partition in the range (metadata the function reports is folded into one result keyed '<partition>/<name>'). 'multi_run' launches one run per partition (optionally capped via Backfill Max Partitions Per Run). Leave empty for Dagster's default. Ignored when no partitioning is configured. This asset returns a MaterializeResult (no IO manager), so single_run needs no range-aware IO manager.

backfill_policy_max_partitions_per_run.label: Backfill Max Partitions Per Run
backfill_policy_max_partitions_per_run.description: For Backfill Policy = 'multi_run' only: maximum partitions materialized per run. Leave empty for Dagster's default (1).

asset_name.description: Dagster asset key emitted by this component. The Modal function may also emit additional asset materializations via ctx.report_asset_materialization().
asset_name.label: Asset Name

app_file.label: App File
app_file.description: Path (relative to Dagster process CWD) to the Python file defining the Modal app + function.

function_args.label: Function Args
function_args.description: Kwargs forwarded to the Modal function via CLI flags (--key=value).

modal_token_id_env_var.label: Modal Token ID Env Var
modal_token_id_env_var.description: Optional — overrides MODAL_TOKEN_ID for the subprocess.

modal_token_secret_env_var.label: Modal Token Secret Env Var
modal_token_secret_env_var.description: Optional — overrides MODAL_TOKEN_SECRET for the subprocess.

partition_type.description: Partition type: 'daily', 'weekly', 'monthly', 'hourly', 'static', 'multi', 'dynamic', or None for unpartitioned.
partition_type.label: Partition Type

partition_start.description: Partition start date in ISO format, e.g. '2024-01-01'. Required for time-based partition types.
partition_start.label: Partition Start

partition_cron_schedule.label: Partition Cron Schedule
partition_cron_schedule.description: Required when partition_type='cron'. A cron expression restricting the date axis to a custom cadence, e.g. '0 0 * * 1-5' for weekdays only (business-day cadence). Built on Dagster's TimeWindowPartitionsDefinition(cron_schedule=...).

partition_cron_fmt.label: Partition Cron Fmt
partition_cron_fmt.description: strftime format for partition keys produced by partition_type='cron'. Only change this for a sub-daily cron_schedule.

partition_end_offset.label: Partition End Offset
partition_end_offset.description: Passed through to the underlying Daily/Weekly/Monthly/Hourly/cron partitions definition. 0 (the Dagster default) means a time-based partition set only ever holds COMPLETED windows -- e.g. a daily set never includes today until tomorrow. Set to 1 to include the current, still-in-progress window.

partition_timezone.label: Partition Timezone
partition_timezone.description: IANA timezone for the underlying Daily/Weekly/Monthly/Hourly/cron partitions definition (defaults to UTC when unset, matching Dagster's own default).

name: Modal Pipes Asset
